blocks.html:
The Career Service fosters direct contact between students and leading professional organizations through workshops, training sessions, and networking opportunities with companies and recruiters.

Below are the main activities and events:

  • Company Presentation: in-class sessions dedicated to introducing professional organizations and internship and job opportunities.
  • Career Management Workshop: sessions focused on developing the skills and transversal competencies needed to launch a professional career.
  • CV Counselling by Industry Experts: individual 20-minute appointments with HR professionals from various fields, focused on CV review and feedback.
  • Meet the Headhunters: sessions with recruitment experts to explore key roles, required competencies, sector trends, major employers, different markets, salaries, and career paths.
  • Long Night of Careers: annual career event featuring workshops, round tables, CV reviews, mock interviews, and interactive activities with companies, alumni, and professors.
  • Career Live Streams: interactive virtual meetings with potential employers, including informational sessions on companies and roles, and possible recruiting sessions.
  • CareerLunch: informal lunch meetings, in person or online, with professionals, to learn about company culture and day-to-day work life.

Check the calendar for upcoming workshops and trainings, and to register.
